title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: HTML conversion and keyword search for Loop and Copilot Pages files
summary: Hold: the statement that conversion runs only when a person selects it overlooks the documented application-permission Graph collection operation. The conversion controls, defaults and premium licensing are otherwise supported, but the claim that exported HTML opens anywhere needs narrowing.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal path reaches the add-to-review-set HTML conversion control.
claims.quote: Select a search on the Searches tab, and then select Add to review set. On the Add items to review set flyout, select Add to a new review set or Add to an existing review set.
claims.fix: The route's entry is confirmed by the already-cited edisc-search-export page. Include the omitted target-selection step, for example: 'eDiscovery > Cases > case > Searches > search > Add to review set > Add to an existing review set > review set > What to include for files from ODSP sites? > Convert supported file formats to HTML'. This is the existing-review-set route on https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-search-add-to-review-set.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Scope; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: POST /v1.0/security/cases/ediscoveryCases/{eDiscoveryCaseId}/reviewSets/{eDiscoveryReviewSetId}/addToReviewSet uses additionalDataOptions to control collection, including cloudNativeHtmlConversion.
claims.quote: additionalDataOptions | microsoft.graph.security.additionalDataOptions | The options to add items to the review set.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal path through Review sets, All items, Action > Export and Export items with item report reaches HTML conversion.
claims.quote: Select the review set that you want to export and select the All items tab. ... Select Action > Export on the command bar. ... Export items with item report ... Convert supported file formats to HTML

claims.claim: No automation option for HTML conversion in a review-set export is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: eDiscovery review set export HTML cloudNativeHtmlConversion exportOptions PowerShell Graph beta. Read ediscoveryExportOperation v1.0 and reviewSet export beta; exportOptions has no cloud-native HTML value. Graph PowerShell search excerpts likewise expose exportOptions, not HTML conversion.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; controls[2].api; What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn documents no UI or API option for exporting .loop and .page files as HTML directly from a search in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: eDiscovery search export Loop page HTML conversion additionalOptions. Read edisc-search-export, exportResult v1.0 and ediscoverySearchExportOperation beta. The UI file options and API additionalOptions omit cloud-native HTML; htmlTranscripts applies to contextual chat messages.

claims.claim: Settings > Role groups > Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions > eDiscovery Manager > Edit > Manage eDiscovery Manager > Choose users is the membership-assignment path.
claims.quote: Go to Settings > Role groups. On Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions, select eDiscovery Manager. ... Select Edit. On Manage eDiscovery Manager, select Choose users or Choose groups.

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember "eDiscoveryManager" -Member <name of security group> adds a mail-enabled security group to the eDiscovery Managers subgroup through Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: You can add a mail-enabled security group as a member of the eDiscovery Managers subgroup ... by using the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Exported HTML opens anywhere, outside Microsoft 365 without the Loop or Copilot Pages apps.
claims.quote: Searched: eDiscovery Loop Pages exported HTML view browser outside Microsoft 365; Loop HTML eDiscovery browser; Copilot Pages HTML anywhere. Read Copilot Pages eDiscovery and review-set export. Microsoft states suitability for workflows supporting HTML, not universal compatibility.
claims.fix: Replace 'They can also give outside parties HTML that opens anywhere' with 'They can export HTML for post-export workflows that support HTML but lack tooling for native cloud file formats.' Replace the corresponding Data exposure sentence with 'HTML conversion supports post-export workflows that support HTML but lack tooling for native cloud file formats.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-review-set-export.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Reviewer provides read-only access to review sets in cases where the user is a member.
claims.quote: Reviewer. Provides read-only access to review sets within eDiscovery cases where the user is a member. Reviewers can view and tag documents but cannot perform other case management tasks.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Case membership and eDiscovery permissions govern access to converted review-set content.
claims.quote: Users who are assigned this role can see and open the list of cases that they're members of. After the user accesses an eDiscovery case, they can select Review sets to access case data.

claims.quote: you must download the content from an export process within 30 days after the export process completes.

claims.claim: Review-set items and metadata are copied into Microsoft-managed Azure Storage dedicated to the case.
claims.quote: When you add content to a review set, the items and their metadata are copied to a Microsoft-managed Azure Storage location dedicated to the case.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-search-export#enable-cmk-customer-managed-key-for-direct-exports-preview.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Conversion runs only when a person selects the option in an add-to-review-set or export process.
claims.quote: Graph API app-only authentication: Graph API calls are made by the application itself, without a user context.
claims.fix: Replace the Autonomy & actions sentence with 'In the portal, conversion is an option selected for an add-to-review-set or review-set export process; both options are unselected by default.' Replace the first sentence of the risk rationale with 'Low. Both portal conversion options are unselected by default.' Do not imply that the Graph collection operation requires a person to select the option for each execution: its v1.0 reference supports application permissions, and its additionalDataOptions enum documents cloudNativeHtmlConversion.

claims.claim: Users require Preview and Export roles to preview and export content with premium eDiscovery features enabled.
